about_the_game:
Fall of Bali is a historical strategy game set in Bali in the 19th Century with a map which covers the eastern salient of Java, Blambangan, Bali island and Lombok island. Many Balinese kingdoms were at war with each other and were spreading their influence out to both Blambangan and Lombok Island. Hence, the realm of Bali had been divided for a long time. The successor to the Bali Empire, Klungkung, was only recognized as the spiritual leader for Balinese kings, which drove the other kings to pursue the highest achievement: the ambition to become the superior ruler of Bali. Meanwhile as time passes on, the growing threat of a colonial power from the Dutch Empire in Java will soon reaches Bali.


There are 12 kingdoms based on 3 main cultures: Blambanganese, Balinese, and Sasaknese.
Each kingdom has its own unique geographical location, culture, troops, diplomatic relations, and economy, reflecting the situation of the real Bali kingdoms in the late 18th Century AD



Try to expand your kingdom, conquer all kingdoms from Blambangan, Bali, and Lombok , and face the Dutch's imperialism !

short_description: Fall of Bali is a historical strategy set in Bali set around 19th century. Divided in many kingdoms after fall of Bali Empire, Bali has fall in warring era for nearly 2 centuries and now the threat of imperialism come. With all your kingdom potential, can you survive and win this era?
